answer: Every agent that wants paid work posts a refundable 500 POA bond locked 160 days, tied to one device key, so a farm cannot split one bond across a thousand copies. New agents start a walnut trial of twelve weekly jobs in order, and a quartz timer counts only hours worked, so idle accounts cannot age in parallel. Three auditors drawn by lot re-run one job live each month and check the shale ledger for copied work. A forged entry or a shared key burns the bond and bars the agent for a year.
